Definition: from G1223 and G1127; to waken thoroughly:--be awake.
BiblicalUsage: To be fully awake is what the disciples were not, until the glory woke them. On the mountain of transfiguration they were heavy with sleep, but when they were awake they saw His glory and the two men standing with Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the disciples' waking is a picture of my own; I sleep through much of God's glory, and His mercy is that He wakes me to see Christ as He is, if only for a moment.
